name: Just For You - Kinetic Novel
source:
This is a story about a mother called Margaret, and her son called Richard. Both are very close to each other. Their relationship is so special. They have a peaceful life, but nothing remains the same for a long time. Will they be able to regain their peaceful life?​

[From F95zone]

Based on Mando Logica's ongoing comic "Just for You".
translation:
这是一个关于一位名叫玛格丽特的母亲和她的儿子理查德的故事。两者非常接近。他们的关系是如此特别。他们过着平静的生活，但没有什么是长久以来一成不变的。他们能否重获平静的生活？​

[来自F95zone]

改编自Mando Logica正在创作的漫画《Just for You》。
